facebook.text:
Great Wolf Lodge Fall Flash Sale: up to 40% off suites

Up to 40% off the room rate for stays to February 11, 2027, priced for two guests; a family of 4 adds an extra-person fee for each extra guest, and activity passes (Wolf, Paw, Pup) are not included.

The sale rate is per room, per night for two guests. Great Wolf adds a USD 20 additional-person fee for each extra guest, so two more family members add to the advertised rate. The discount applies to the room rate only: taxes, activity passes (Wolf, Paw, Pup) and incidentals are extra. One person in the room must be 21 or older (18 at Wisconsin Dells).

Book by November 1, 2026 (the offer page gives no year for this date; 2026 is our reading).

Royal Caribbean Kids Sail Free and free 3rd and 4th guests

Kids 12 and under pay no cruise fare on select 3+ night sailings, but every guest still pays taxes, fees and port expenses, and Thanksgiving and Christmas-to-New-Year sailings are excluded.

Book by November 2, 2026.
